Harbor notice for the winter season, set in a tight heading over two lines

During the winter the north quay closes at dusk, and vessels waiting for a berth anchor in the outer roads until the harbor master calls them in.1 The pilot boat keeps its usual hours and its usual channel, and the NEW night signal is shown from the breakwater light.

Vessels leaving after dark report to the harbor office by radio before they cast off, and again once they are clear of the breakwater, so that the office knows which berths are free for the morning tide and which pilots to call.

Related notices from the harbor office this season

The south quay is open as usual.

1 The outer roads are marked on the harbor chart.
